characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 青年。１９歳 (young man); en.wikipedia protagonist 'he'; ja.wikipedia 主人公
characters.position: Orguss pilot; Freedom Space Corps fighter pilot (second lieutenant) thrown 20 years forward; a Singularity travelling with the Emaan Factory caravan aboard the Glomar
characters.personality: hot-blooded and straightforward on the surface, but easygoing at heart and an incorrigible womanizer; natural genius pilot; later takes responsibility for the chaos he caused
sources: library pilot 65 DSCR (直情型で熱血漢, 根が軽い性格で無類の女好き)

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 青年。２５歳; ja.wikipedia: Kei's academy friend and wingman; en.wikipedia 'Kei's best friend ... he'
characters.position: the other Singularity; Chiram special-duty major general (特務少将) who was Athena's guardian and instructor, then leaves the army to fight beside Kei
characters.personality: serious, dutiful and caring (a steady foil to Kei), harsh on himself and others out of patriotism until he comes round; deep loyalty to Kei

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 外見は人間の少女と変わらず (looks like a human girl); ja.wikipedia: 人間の少女そのもののデザイン; en.wikipedia 'little girl', 'her'. An android, but built and presented as a girl
characters.position: humanoid (android) built in Mu for nursing and repair; bought by Kei and became a member of the Glomar crew; ends by sacrificing her energy to save Mimsy
characters.personality: devoted, gentle and capable (housework, repairs, nursing); human-equivalent emotions, in love with Kei who is her benefactor

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: 桂とティナの娘 (daughter), 彼女, 第一級の女戦士; ja.wikipedia: チラム陣営の女性エースパイロット
characters.position: Chiram army ace pilot (enlisted as a child soldier at 11, second lieutenant per ja.wikipedia); Kei and Tina's daughter and Olson's ward; later fights on Kei's side
characters.personality: strong-willed and stubborn; resents the father she never knew, then reconciles; resolves to fight so no one else suffers as she did; devoted to Olson

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: エマーン人の少女。１７歳; ja.wikipedia: ブラウンのストレートヘアを持つエマーン人の少女
characters.position: member of the Factory (vice-captain and tactician of the Glomar per en.wikipedia); heir of the Laaz family; Slay's fiancee, then Kei's partner
characters.personality: lively and proactive (ja.wikipedia: 活発で積極的); honest about her feelings, sharp with business sense, torn between duty and love; recovers from Slay's death

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR: エマーン人の女性 (woman), 彼女, 妹マニーシャ; ja.wikipedia 赤毛のエマーン人女性; https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/シャイア・トーブ 性別 女
characters.position: chief of the Factory (captain of the Glomar); eldest daughter of the Thoov family; twin sister of Manisha; protects Kei against Chiram and her own sister, then allies with Chiram to repair spacetime
characters.personality: scholarly and thoughtful but sheltered and goes at her own pace (DSCR); ja.wikipedia adds indecisive and optimistic yet trusted by everyone

characters.gender_evidence: DSCR is deliberately neutral (no pronoun), but en.wikipedia writes 'allows him to sense Kei', voiced by male actors (銀河万丈, Steven Blum), and Jigoku shipped English (rt_000) says 'the world he originally came from'
characters.position: Glomar crew member; dinosaur/dragon-like Earthling from a parallel universe searching for a lost lover; fire-breathing draw for customers, senses spacetime transfers with his tail; named the Orguss
characters.personality: calm, gentle and level-headed (ja.wikipedia: 穏やかで冷静), useful and loyal; recollections show a wandering eye; despairs at his ruined homeland but Kei talks him back

left_pending: ランチ: no source anywhere names Shaya's lover in English (not in akurasu, MAL, Wikipedia, ja.wikipedia cast, fan guides). Recorded as proposed 'Lunch' (literal reading) so the build has something, but it is unsettled; 'Launch' or 'Ranch' are conceivable.
challenges: Jigoku shipped English (user's earlier release) used 'Shaia Toube', 'Mimsy Lars' and 'Groma' (kw_066, pt_040). These are not glossary entries, so no official/confirmed name is being overruled, but the Tengoku names follow akurasu Z Pilot_Database and the licensed English instead: 'Shaya Thoov', 'Mimsy Laaz', 'Glomar' (https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/Z/Pilot_Database ; MAL https://myanimelist.net/anime/2089/Choujikuu_Seiki_Orguss/characters ; Wikipedia). If the orchestrator prefers continuity with the Jigoku release, switch these three (and 'Thoov/Laaz family') together.

jigoku_glossary.json entry 'Spacequake Bomb' (時空震動弾, proposed) differs from the licensed 'Space/Time Oscillation Bomb' (Wikipedia, ANN); not challenged because the game's 時空震動 is officially 'Spacequake' and the bomb should follow it.
retoken: pt_062 entry 68 (Athena DSCR): '$$ムウ$$' -> '$$ムウ#orguss$$' (Orguss Mu, the machine nation, not Mu La Flaga)
Any Tengoku prose for library entries 66 (Olson), 67 (Mome) or other Orguss text that writes '$$ムウ$$' must use '$$ムウ#orguss$$' as well
pt_062 entry 68: '$$マイケル$$' -> '$$マイケル#orguss$$' (optional: English is 'Michael' either way, but it should not bind to the Gundam 00 movie Michael Chan)
オルソン: the glossary also has the Gundam 00 movie オルソン (entry 130) with English 'Olson'; bind by library entry/target, no retoken needed since the English is identical
uncertain: Shaya vs Shaia and Toube/Thoov: akurasu Z Pilot_Database, MAL, Wikipedia and the dub say Shaya Thoov; the akurasu Z Timeline page says 'Shaia', Jigoku shipped 'Shaia Toube', ja romanization is Shaia Tobe. Went with akurasu Pilot_Database (highest precedence for pilot names).
Mimsy Laaz vs Larz vs Lars: akurasu + MAL say Laaz, Wikipedia Larz, Jigoku Lars. Went with akurasu.

Glomar: akurasu Z Mech_List has 'Gloma', Pilot_Database/Timeline have 'Glomar' (also 'Glommar' once), Jigoku 'Groma'. Chose Glomar (majority incl. English sources). Kind set to robot (ship), the brief listed it as keyword.

Olson vs Orson: Wikipedia and akurasu Z Pilot_Database/Timeline say Orson; akurasu Secrets/Unit_Database, MAL and the Jigoku glossary say Olson. Kept Olson (the glossary CHFN 'Olson D. Verne' is official).
Manisha: spelling has no authoritative source (fan guide 'Manisha', Wikipedia 'Maneesha', MAL 'Maniisha'). Marked proposed.
Slay: dub credit (ANN/Wikipedia) spelling; fan guides also write Sray/Sley and Discotek's own subtitles could differ (could not read the subtitles). Marked official on the dub credit alone.
Chiram: chosen per akurasu and Discotek ('Chiram'); ja.wikipedia's official romanization is TERRAM, Wikipedia also shows Chilam/Chilum.

混乱時空 / 混乱時空世紀: no official English. Went with 'chaotic spacetime' (world/state) and 'Chaotic Era' (calendar, capitalized). Jigoku shipped 'chaotic era' for the bare 混乱時空 and 'spacetime chaos' for 時空混乱; if the orchestrator wants Jigoku continuity, use 'chaotic era' for both. 'Spacetime' is one word to match the glossary's Spacequake/Spacetime Repair, whereas akurasu Z writes 'Space-Time Crash'.
特異点: Discotek writes 'the singularity' in lower case; Jigoku and Wikipedia capitalize it when it names the person. Set 'Singularity'; the library's |lc marker gives lower case where needed.
Jabby's gender: the game DSCR avoids pronouns; profile says male from Wikipedia ('him') and Jigoku shipped ('he'). The pt_062 translation used 'they'; translator should decide.
Mome gender: android, but built and presented as a girl; recorded as female rather than 'not applicable'.
Tina: pt_062 guessed she was short for クリスティナ・シエラ (Gundam 00); she is Tina Henderson of Orguss. Note the game says Tina died in the Mu attack while Wikipedia says she died ill; the game text governs.
Pilot 65-67 full DSCR text was read from work/tengoku/prepared/library_inventory.json (records 208-210); the brief's copy was truncated.
